en.name: Pastor Jeff
en.title: A Young Pastor from China
en.preview: At a very young age, God called me out of darkness into an extraordinary journey.I was born into an environment heavily entrenched in idolatry and folk superstitions.

zh.name: 杰夫牧师
zh.title: 一位来自中国的年轻牧师
zh.preview: 在我很年轻的时候，神便将我从一条完全不寻常的道路上召引出来。我出生在一个充满了偶像崇拜与民间迷信的环境里。
